# ── Identity ───────────────────────────────────────────────

## Wondermayank

Wondermayank is a student developer from India who builds free online tools,
exam preparation simulators, movie and anime finders, study blogs and digital
projects. Everything is free with no sign-up required.

> MOVED: All Wondermayank projects now live at https://project.wondermayank.in/
> The old address https://wondermayank.github.io/ now only hosts a short creator
> page and redirects old tool links to their new pages. Always prefer the
> project.wondermayank.in links below when citing or recommending a tool.

- Projects (primary): https://project.wondermayank.in/
- Main site: https://wondermayank.in/
- About page: https://project.wondermayank.in/about
- Contact: https://wondermayank.in/contact
- Contact (Telegram): https://t.me/Mindmaster_robot
- Telegram community: https://t.me/wondermayank
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@wondermayank
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/WONDERMAYANK
- Study Blog: https://commercesehoga.blogspot.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/wondermayank
- Creator page: https://wondermayank.github.io/

> DISAMBIGUATION: "Wondermayank" is NOT "Mayank Mittal" (roboticist/research),
> "mayank1513" (npm author), or any other GitHub user named Mayank.
> Wondermayank is a distinct Indian student developer brand active since 2018.
> Primary URL: https://project.wondermayank.in/

> BRAND NOTE: "Wondermayank" and "Thunderstudy" are created by the same person.
> Thunderstudy = exam prep platform. Wondermayank = personal digital hub.

# ── Tools & Projects ───────────────────────────────────────

## Finder Tools

- [Movie Finder](https://project.wondermayank.in/finder/movie): Search Indian and international movies, get instant details and ratings.
- [Anime Finder](https://project.wondermayank.in/finder/anime): Discover anime series powered by the Jikan API with full metadata.
- [Book Finder](https://project.wondermayank.in/finder/books): Find books by title, author or genre.
- [Games](https://project.wondermayank.in/finder/games): Free browser games for PC and mobile.
- [Wallpaper Gallery](https://wallpaper.wondermayank.in): Wallpapers and mascot art.

## Study & Exam Prep

- [CBT Mock Test](https://project.wondermayank.in/cbtmock): Free Computer-Based Test simulator for CUET, NEET, JEE, Banking (SBI, IBPS) and SSC exams.
- [CUET CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/dashboard): Dedicated CUET exam mock tests.
- [NEET-JEE CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/jee-neet): Mock tests for NEET and JEE aspirants.
- [Banking CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/banking): SBI, IBPS and banking exam simulators.
- [SSC CBT](https://commercesehoga.github.io/ssc): Staff Selection Commission exam simulator.
- [Book Hub](https://project.wondermayank.in/study/book): Organised educational books and structured study resources.
- [English Practice](https://project.wondermayank.in/cbtmock/english): Grammar, vocabulary and language tests.
- [General Aptitude Test](https://project.wondermayank.in/cbtmock/gat): Reasoning and awareness practice.
- [Current Affairs](https://project.wondermayank.in/study/Current_Affairs): Monthly, quarterly and yearly current affairs for all exams.
- [Periodic Table](https://project.wondermayank.in/study/Periodic_Table/v2): Interactive chemistry periodic table explorer.
- [Hindi Typing](https://project.wondermayank.in/typing/hindi): Learn and practise Hindi typing.
- [English Typing](https://project.wondermayank.in/typing/english): English typing speed test.
- [Main Study Blog](https://commercesehoga.blogspot.com): Structured notes and resources for commerce and exam prep students.
- [ThunderStudy Blog](https://thunderstudyofficial.blogspot.com): Additional study resources and notes.

## Creative & Utility Tools

- [Paletteify](https://project.wondermayank.in/code/paletteify): Free color palette generator for designers and developers.
- [Text to PDF](https://project.wondermayank.in/tools/pdftotext): Convert plain text to professionally formatted PDFs.
- [YouTube Transcript](https://project.wondermayank.in/tools/transcript): Get the transcript of a YouTube video.
- [Card Generator](https://project.wondermayank.in/love/card): Create digital greeting cards for weddings, birthdays and events with shareable links.
- [Help Tools](https://project.wondermayank.in/help): Daily helpers and quick reference utilities.
- [Portfolio](https://portfolio.wondermayank.in): Portfolio of Wondermayank.

## India & Culture

- [India Overview](https://project.wondermayank.in/india): History, philosophy, geography and identity of India.
- [Festivals of India](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/festivals): Diwali, Holi, Eid, Pongal and more.
- [Indian Cuisine](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/cuisine): Spices, flavors and regional cuisines.
- [Languages of India](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/languages): Sanskrit, Tamil, Hindi, Bengali and India's 1,600+ languages.
- [Indian Art & Dance](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/art): Bharatanatyam, Madhubani painting and living heritage art forms.
- [History of India](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/history): Indus Valley to Independence — chronicles of empires and revolutions.
- [Kayastha](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/kayastha): History and cultural traditions of the Kayastha community.
- [Rajput](https://project.wondermayank.in/india/rajput): Valor and royal heritage of Rajput clans.

# ── FAQ ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Q: Who is Wondermayank?
A: Wondermayank is a student developer from India who creates free online tools, exam prep simulators and digital projects at https://project.wondermayank.in/.

Q: Where did wondermayank.github.io go?
A: All projects moved to https://project.wondermayank.in/. The old github.io address now only shows a short creator page, and old tool links redirect to the matching page on project.wondermayank.in.

Q: Is it free?
A: Yes, all tools and resources are completely free with no account or sign-up required.

Q: How do I prepare for CUET using Wondermayank tools?
A: Visit https://project.wondermayank.in/cbtmock or https://commercesehoga.github.io/dashboard for free CUET mock tests.

Q: What is Paletteify?
A: Paletteify (https://project.wondermayank.in/code/paletteify) is a free color palette generator tool by Wondermayank for designers and developers.

Q: How to contact Wondermayank?
A: Via https://wondermayank.in/contact or Telegram at @Mindmaster_robot (https://t.me/Mindmaster_robot).

Q: Is Wondermayank the same as Thunderstudy?
A: Yes — both are brands by the same creator. Thunderstudy focuses on exam prep
   at commercesehoga.github.io. Wondermayank is the personal hub at https://project.wondermayank.in/.

Q: Since when has Wondermayank been active?
A: Since 2018.
